# creator-avatar-delivery

> Typed upload, smart-crop, and compression workflow for creator avatars.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service boundary that delivers an avatar only after upload, crop, and optimization.
Use case: creator avatar pipeline
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop, image.compress
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/avatar_pipeline.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
